questions: What replaces the vmware_rest lookup plugins?

answer_card.title: vmware_rest lookups deprecated
answer_card.answer_md: All `vmware.vmware_rest` lookup plugins are deprecated. Use `vmware.vmware.moid_from_path` instead.
